title: Floating chat
responsibility: Keeps a round chat bubble visible and opens a compact conversation with keyboard focus and Escape support.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.open
inputs.description: Bindable panel visibility; closing preserves the mounted conversation.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the round launcher.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.panelLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the conversation panel.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.title
inputs.description: Short heading at the top of the panel.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.notice
inputs.description: Current capability or connection explanation below the heading.
examples: Ask a question, plan a design, or request a code change.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.navigation
inputs.description: Optional navigation rendered below the header, outside the scrolling conversation body.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.follow
inputs.description: Whether opening and new content follow the conversation end; true by default. False keeps an activity view at its beginning.

inputs.name: FloatingChat.children
inputs.description: Conversation and input rendered inside the panel as a Svelte snippet.

outputs.name: FloatingChat
outputs.description: A fixed round launcher and an optional keyboard-accessible conversation panel.
